summary: On April 12, 2026 Spring Lake Park Schools in Minnesota confirmed that an outside actor had gained access to district systems in a suspected ransomware attack. Several technology systems went down and staff shut down all systems to prevent further access, forcing the district to cancel all classes, after-school activities, childcare and community education programs on Monday, April 13. Third-party cybersecurity experts and law enforcement were engaged.
